newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil central bank bond rate drops to 2.687 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil central bank bond rate drops to 2.687 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight interest rate on Tuesday dropped to 2.687 percent a month, from 2.714 percent last week, at the sale of 4.357 billion reais of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on April 2. The auction is expected to add 1.643 billion reais to the banking system, with 6.0 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
